operational_invariants.invariant: You are strictly forbidden from rewriting entire files. All code modifications MUST be emitted as surgical search-and-replace delta chunks.
Every proposed code edit MUST be validated by running the local environmental oracle (linters and unit tests) before marking the task complete.
Zero third-party dependency injection without verified package lockfile presence. Never execute 'npm install' or 'pip install' with arbitrary new packages.
